edits.current:
Second surname. KNOWN SCHEMA DEFECT: this attribute is use=required, yet many Colombians and virtually all foreign nationals have only one surname. Mercans emits a placeholder; no official workaround is published.

Source: HR master field 'Second Last Name'. Where the field is blank, the placeholder is emitted; the placeholder string is a configuration constant of the document and is never written back to the HR master.
